{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Giant EP029.png|thumb|250px|Giant]] '''Giant''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|Ｇ|ジャイアント}}{{tt|高田|たかだ}}''' ''Giant Takada'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP029|The Punchy Pokémon]]''. ==History== [[File:Giant locked up.png|thumb|left|220px|Giant, tied up, and stripped by [[Jessie]]]] Giant and his {{p|Hitmonlee}} were going to be competitors in the [[P1 Grand Prix]]. {{TRT}} wanted to compete as well, so they could win the grand prize. Realizing they didn't have any {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon, they decided to steal one. Unfortunately for Giant, his Hitmonlee was the first Pokémon the trio saw. Somehow, they snuck up on him, tied him up, stole his clothes, and locked him in a bathroom stall. Using his Hitmonlee, Team Rocket entered the tournament disguised as Giant, and managed to get to the finals. However, {{Ash}} caught on to their plan, when trying to beat them in the finals (with James poking his head out helping to spoil the disguise and have Ash and his friends deduce Team Rocket's involvement), and was able to defeat them with his {{AP|Primeape}}. It is not known what happened to Giant after Team Rocket robbed him. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Giant's known Pokémon: ===Status unknown=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Giant |pkmn=Hitmonlee |gender=male |type1=Fighting |epnum=EP029 |epname=The Punchy Pokémon |vaen=Michael Haigney |img=Giant Hitmonlee.png |desc=Hitmonlee is Giant's only known Pokémon. He was seen walking with Giant before [[Jessie]] tied him up and used Hitmonlee during the tournament. Hitmonlee's first match in the tournament was [[Brock's Geodude]], but due to it taking a lot of damage, {{an|Brock}} threw in the towel. Hitmonlee later defeated a {{p|Machoke}} and {{OBP|Anthony|EP029}}'s {{p|Hitmonchan}}, though unfairly. Hitmonlee, however, was defeated by {{AP|Primeape}} under Ash and Anthony's guidance. It is unknown if Hitmonlee was returned to Giant. Hitmonlee's known moves are {{m|Jump Kick}}{{tt|*|Incorrectly dubbed as Mega Kick}} and {{m|High Jump Kick}}{{tt|*|Japanese version only}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fighting color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=石塚運昇 ''[[Unshō Ishizuka]]'' |en=Unknown |es_eu=José Escobosa }} ==Trivia== * Giant's Japanese and English names are a reference to the professional Japanese wrestler {{wp|Giant Baba}}.
